name: Takasu Yasuko
source: Yasuko is Ryuuji's thirty-three-year-old mother, though she refers to herself as eternally twenty-three; she has large, F-cup-sized breasts. She works at a hostess bar named Bishamonten Kuni where she goes by the name "Mirano".
